user.title: UK Heat Network (ARM-Hub)
user.description:
Enter your ARM-Hub portal credentials. Currently tested with ARM Hub (spot-on-energy.arm-hub.com). Other providers on arm-hub.com may work.

The auth addon must be installed and running before you continue.

**Finding your API key:** log in to your heat network's portal in a browser (for example spot-on-energy.arm-hub.com), open the developer tools console, then paste this and press Enter:

```
{key_snippet}
```

It prints a 32-character key, which only appears on your screen. If it says the key wasn't found, open the Network tab, reload the page, select a request to api.armadillo-analytics.com, and copy its `Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key` header.
